prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready tileable base-color texture for an original 1650 Chinese sailing ship in a realistic 3D naval game. Single square flat material texture, edge-to-edge. Orthographic material scan, uniform diffuse albedo, no directional lighting, no highlights, no cast shadows, no perspective, no background, no borders, no labels, no text, no objects, no watermark. Seamless repeat on both axes. Rich believable fine detail but restrained contrast; attractive antique maritime craftsmanship, not fantasy grime. Subject: continuous aged oiled Chinese fir hardwood surface with long fine horizontal grain running exactly left to right, warm desaturated chestnut and burnt umber, muted honey-worn fibers, delicate hairline grain and occasional tiny pores, subtle sea-salt weathering, hand-finished patina. The whole image is wood surface. No separate planks, no board joints, no nailheads, no large knots, no rotten holes, no stripes that form a grid. Midtone-rich rather than nearly black; physical plank seams are supplied by the 3D mesh.
